summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 21, 2026, reporting operational treasury updates rather than a special situation. The company disclosed that SOL and SOL equivalents grew by 101,381 between September 14 and September 18, 2026, rising from 2,388,923 to 2,490,304, a 4% increase, to be deployed via staking and onchain treasury infrastructure. It also noted R.F. Lafferty's closing of the over-allotment option from its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock IPO. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
